python3 -c "
import re

def slugify(text: str, sep: str = '-') -> str:
    lowered = text.lower()
    replaced = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', sep, lowered)
    if sep:
        esc = re.escape(sep)
        return re.sub(f'^(?:{esc})+|(?:{esc})+$', '', replaced)
    return replaced

print(repr(slugify('  Hello, World!! ')))
print(repr(slugify('A B', sep='_')))
print(repr(slugify('A B', sep='--')))
print(repr(slugify('ab', sep='-a-')))
"
